tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Read the canonical Markdown of one docs page by id, or a single section when an anchor is supplied. Returns the page/section URL, content hash, maturity, effective availability, and last-reviewed date alongside the markdown. Unknown page ids or anchors return a clean not-found error.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search the Bondren public docs corpus for ranked sections matching a query. Limit defaults to 5, and the ranked result set is the top 10 matching sections.
